setup_distributed_process_group: setup a distributed process group using gloo backend with a given rank and world size
sync_params_broadcast: synchronize a sequence of tensors across all ranks from rank 0 using broadcast
broadcast_tensors: broadcast float or complex tensors from a source rank to all distributed workers
freeze_joints: freeze selected joint rotations in a tensor by copying the first frame values across the sequence
timer_class: create a Timer instance to measure elapsed time with optional iterations per second reporting
